phew.englishDescription: An exclamation that comes with a loud, long sigh, uttered when one is finished with a difficult task or turns a corner.

phew.definitionKo: 일이 힘들거나 걱정이 있을 때 크고 길게 내쉬는 소리.
phew.englishDescription: An exclamation that comes with a loud, long sigh, uttered when one feels tired or worried.

phew.definitionKo: 어려운 일을 끝내거나 고비를 넘겼을 때 안심하여 크고 길게 내쉬는 소리.
phew.englishDescription: An exclamation that comes with a loud, long sigh, uttered when one is finished with a difficult task or turns a corner.

phoenix.definitionKo: 여러 동물의 모양을 하고 있으며, 복되고 길한 일을 상징하는 상상 속의 새.
phoenix.englishDescription: An imaginary bird with the looks of many different animals, which symbolizes luck and goodness.

phoenix.definitionKo: 여러 동물의 모양을 하고 있으며, 복되고 길한 일을 상징하는 상상 속의 새.
phoenix.englishDescription: An imaginary bird with the features of many different animals, which symbolizes luck and good fortune.

phoenix.definitionKo: 여러 동물의 모양을 하고 있으며, 복되고 길한 일을 상징하는 상상 속의 새.
phoenix.englishDescription: An imaginary bird resembling many different animals that symbolizes good fortune and auspiciousness.

phoenix.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 영원히 죽지 않는다는 전설의 새와 같이, 어떠한 어려움이나 고난도 이겨 내는 사람.
phoenix.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who overcomes all difficulties or hardships like the legendary bird that is said to never die.

pilgrimage.definitionKo: 종교가 처음 일어난 곳이나 성인의 무덤 등 종교적으로 의미가 있는 곳을 찾아다니며 참배함.
pilgrimage.englishDescription: The act of visiting places of religious significance such as the place where a religion was founded, a saint's grave, etc., and paying respects.
An act of paying respects at a shrine or making a trip to a shrine.

pillar.definitionKo: 건축물에서 천장이나 지붕처럼 윗부분에 올리는 구조물을 떠받치는 긴 구조물.
pillar.englishDescription: In a building, a tall, elongated structure that supports the upper parts such as a ceiling or roof.

pillar.definitionKo: 밑에서 위로 곧게 세워져 어떤 것을 받치거나 버티는 가늘고 긴 물건.
pillar.englishDescription: A long, narrow object set up vertically to support or sustain something.

pillar.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 집안이나 단체, 나라에서 의지가 될 만한 중요한 사람이나 중심이 되는 것.
pillar.englishDescription: (figurative) In a family, group, or country, an important person or central thing that can be relied on.

pillar.definitionKo: 기둥과 기둥을 연결하기 위해 그 사이에 가로질러 놓는 큰 기둥.
pillar.englishDescription: A large pillar placed across pillars to connect them.

pillar.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 한 나라 또는 집안에서 없어서는 안 될 중요한 사람.
pillar.englishDescription: (figurative) An important person who is indispensable to a country or family.

pillar.definitionKo: 무엇이 쓰러지지 않도록 받쳐 세운 기둥.
pillar.englishDescription: A pillar placed against something to keep it from falling.

pillar.definitionKo: 어떤 물건이 넘어지지 않도록 버팀이 되는 기둥.
pillar.englishDescription: A column that props up something to keep it from falling down.

pinwheel.definitionKo: 종이를 여러 갈래로 자르고 끝을 구부려 날개를 만들고 막대에 붙여서 바람을 받으면 돌게 만든 장난감.
pinwheel.englishDescription: A toy with sails of paper cut into multiple strips, bent into waves, and then pinned to a stick so that they revolve in the wind.

pinwheel.definitionKo: 종이를 여러 갈래로 자르고 끝을 구부려 날개를 만들고 막대에 붙여서 바람을 받으면 돌게 만든 장난감.
pinwheel.englishDescription: A toy with sails of paper cut into multiple strips, bent into waves, and then pinned to a stick so that they revolve in the wind.

plain.englishDescription: Simple and plain.

plain.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
plain.englishDescription: A situation or circumstances being so clear and apparent as to be understood even without careful consideration.
Plain, neither luxurious nor showy.
A field with grass.
The taste of food feeling refreshing, not greasy.

plain.definitionKo: 보기 좋고 그럴듯하게 만드는 것 없이 있는 그대로 진실되다.
plain.englishDescription: Something being faithful to what it actually is without being artificially made to look nicer.

plain.definitionKo: 글이나 말의 내용이 꾸밈이 없어 주관적이지 않고 차분하다.
plain.englishDescription: Straightforward, objective, and calm in writing or speech .

plain.definitionKo: 맛이 짜거나 느끼하지 않고 싱거운 듯 산뜻하다.
plain.englishDescription: Neither salty nor greasy, flat but clean tasting.
Tasting fresh, not oily.
A vast expanse of fields.
An expanse of flat, broad land.
Not pretty or good-looking.
Common without distinct features or changes.
Wide, flat, open land with no fences, etc.

plain.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보지 않아도 알 수 있을 만큼 상황이나 사정이 확실하거나 분명하다.
plain.englishDescription: A situation or reasons being so clear and distinct as to be figured out even without careful consideration.
The taste of food not being strong but mild.

plain.definitionKo: 물건의 품질이나 겉모양, 또는 사람의 옷차림 등이 돋보이거나 화려하지 않고 평범하면서도 검소하다.
plain.englishDescription: The quality or appearance of something, or one's dress, being ordinary and humble, neither too conspicuous nor fancy.
A wide field whose surface is flat.
A vast, flat field.
Easy, neither picky nor difficult.
One's looks or appearance looking common and ordinary.

planner.definitionKo: 행사나 일 등의 절차와 내용을 미리 자세하게 계획하는 사람.
planner.englishDescription: A person who makes a detailed plan of the procedure and content of an event in advance.

planner.definitionKo: 건축, 보험, 재무 등에 관해 계획하는 일을 전문으로 하는 사람.
planner.englishDescription: A person who specializes in making plans on architecture, insurance, financial affairs, etc.
A person who plans movies or television shows.

playful.definitionKo: 진정이 아니라 즐기거나 놀이 삼아 하는.
playful.englishDescription: Doing something for fun, not with a serious intention.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 터지는 소리가 계속해서 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 계속해서 내다.
pop.englishDescription: For the sound of a balloon's popping out or bomb's blowing up to be made continuously; or to make such a sound continuously.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 시끄럽게 터지는 소리.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a balloon, bomb, etc., explodes suddenly and loudly.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 계속해서 시끄럽게 터지는 소리.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a balloon, bomb, etc., explodes suddenly, repeatedly, and loudly.

pop.definitionKo: 무엇을 둘러싸고 있는 표면을 눌러서 터지게 하다.
pop.englishDescription: To press the surface surrounding something and make it burst open.

pop.definitionKo: 무엇을 둘러싸고 있는 표면을 눌러서 터지게 하다.
pop.englishDescription: To press the surface surrounding something and make it burst open.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 계속해서 터지는 소리.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a balloon, bomb, etc., explodes suddenly and repeatedly.

pop.definitionKo: 작은 것이 갑자기 튀거나 터지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a small thing suddenly pops up or bursts open, or describing such a scene.

pop.definitionKo: 작은 것이 갑자기 튀거나 터지는 소리가 자꾸 나다.
pop.englishDescription: For sounds to be made repeatedly when small things to suddenly pop up or burst open.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 시끄럽게 터지는 소리.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a balloon, bomb, etc., explodes suddenly and loudly.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 계속해서 시끄럽게 터지는 소리.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a balloon, bomb, etc., explodes suddenly, repeatedly, and loudly.

pop.definitionKo: 갑자기 튀거나 터지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
pop.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when something suddenly pops up or bursts open, or describing such a scene.

pop.definitionKo: 마른 곡식의 알 등에 열을 가하여서 부풀게 하다.
pop.englishDescription: To heat dried grains, etc., making them inflate.

pop.definitionKo: 풍선이나 폭탄 등이 갑자기 터지는 소리가 계속해서 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 계속해서 내다.
pop.englishDescription: For the sound of a balloon's popping out or bomb's blowing up to be made continuously; or to make such a sound continuously.

pop.definitionKo: 작은 것이 갑자기 튀거나 터지는 소리가 자꾸 나다.
pop.englishDescription: For sounds to be made repeatedly when small things to suddenly pop up or burst open.

poppy.definitionKo: 희거나 붉은 색의 아름다운 꽃이 피며, 열매는 아편을 만드는 데 쓰이는 풀.
poppy.englishDescription: A plant that bears beautiful white or red flowers, and seeds used for making opium.

postmortem.definitionKo: 사망 원인이 범죄로 인한 것인지를 알기 위해 시체를 검사함.
postmortem.englishDescription: Dissecting and inspecting a corpse to determine whether the cause of death was a crime.

poutingly.definitionKo: 기분이 좋지 않거나 울려고 할 때, 또는 비웃을 때 소리 없이 입을 내밀고 실룩거리는 모양.
poutingly.englishDescription: In the manner of pouting and twitching one's lips when one feels unpleasant, feels like crying, or laughs at someone or something.
In the manner of sticking out one's lips.

poutingly.definitionKo: 입술 끝을 뾰족하게 자꾸 내미는 모양.
poutingly.englishDescription: In the manner of sticking out one's lips repeatedly.

precipitation.definitionKo: 일정한 기간 동안 일정한 곳에 비나 눈 등이 내려 생기는 물의 양.
precipitation.englishDescription: The quantity of water that comes from rain or snow that fall on a particular location during a particular period of time.

precipitation.definitionKo: 일정 기간 동안 일정한 곳에 내린 비의 양.
precipitation.englishDescription: The amount of rain that fell on a certain location during a certain period of time.

precipitation.definitionKo: 액체 속에 들어 있는 물질이 밑바닥으로 가라앉음. 또는 그 물질.
precipitation.englishDescription: An act of a substance contained in a liquid sinking to the bottom, or such a substance.

preposterously.definitionKo: 너무 뜻밖의 일을 당해서 기가 막히는 듯하게.
preposterously.englishDescription: In a manner of being dumbfounded due to an extremely unexpected occurrence.

preposterously.definitionKo: 너무 뜻밖의 일을 당해서 기가 막히는 듯하게.
preposterously.englishDescription: In a manner of being dumbfounded due to an extremely unexpected occurrence.

procedure.englishDescription: A system or procedure of a work.

procedure.definitionKo: 일을 해 나갈 때 거쳐야 하는 순서나 방법.
procedure.englishDescription: An order or method that one should go through in doing something.

procedure.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하거나 어떤 일이 일어나는 순서.
procedure.englishDescription: An order by which one does a certain task or a sequence in which work is done.

procedure.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하거나 어떤 일이 이루어지는 차례.
procedure.englishDescription: An order by which one does a certain task or a sequence in which work is done.

procedure.definitionKo: 일을 시작하거나 처리하기 전에 거쳐야 할 과정이나 단계.
procedure.englishDescription: A procedure or process that is to be gone through before starting or handling a matter.

progenitor.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 맨 처음 시작한 사람.
progenitor.englishDescription: A person who began something for the first time.

progenitor.definitionKo: 민족, 왕조, 가계 등의 맨 처음이 되는 조상.
progenitor.englishDescription: The first ancestor of an ethnic group, dynasty, family, etc.

proving.definitionKo: 수학이나 논리학에서, 어떤 명제나 판단이 진실인지 아닌지를 근본 원리로부터 이끌어 내어 밝힘.
proving.englishDescription: The act of demonstrating that a proposition or judgment is true by using fundamental principles, in mathematics or logic.

puerility.englishDescription: An immature and childish mood or emotion.

pyeong.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for measuring an area of land.

quarantine.definitionKo: 전염병을 막기 위해 공항이나 항구 등에서 병균이 있는지를 검사함.
quarantine.englishDescription: Inspecting whether there are germs in airports and shipping ports to prevent the spread of contagious diseases.

quarantine.definitionKo: 전염병을 막기 위해 공항이나 항구 등에서 병균이 있는지를 검사하다.
quarantine.englishDescription: To inspect something at airports and seaports to find out whether there are germs in it as a preventive measure against the spread of contagious diseases.

quarantine.definitionKo: 전염병 환자나 면역력이 약한 환자를 다른 곳으로 떼어 놓음.
quarantine.englishDescription: Moving the patients of a contagious disease or people with weak immunity to a designated protective place.

quarantine.definitionKo: 전염병 환자나 면역력이 약한 환자를 다른 곳으로 떼어 놓다.
quarantine.englishDescription: To move people with a contagious disease or those with weak immunity to a designated protective place.

quiescence.definitionKo: 동식물이 생활 기능을 활발히 하지 않거나 성장을 멈추는 일.
quiescence.englishDescription: A state in animals and plants do not perform life functions actively or stop growing.

refer.englishDescription: To make reference to or mention something specifically.

refer.definitionKo: 어떤 문제를 투표, 재판 회의 등의 대상이 되게 하다.
refer.englishDescription: To make something the subject of a vote, trial, meeting, etc.

refer.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 어떤 이름으로 가리켜 이르다.
refer.englishDescription: To refer to something as something.

refer.definitionKo: 어떤 문제나 서류, 사건 등을 관계 기관이나 회의, 재판 등에 돌려보내거나 넘기다.
refer.englishDescription: To return or pass over a certain issue, document, case, etc., to the relevant authority, meeting, trial, etc.

renounce.definitionKo: 자기의 권리나 자격, 소유한 물건 등을 버리다.
renounce.englishDescription: To give up one's right, qualification, belongings, etc.

renounce.definitionKo: 계약, 조약, 약속 등을 깨뜨려 버리다.
renounce.englishDescription: To break a contract, treaty, promise, etc.

resending.englishDescription: The act of sending again what was sent earlier.

reticent.englishDescription: One's personality being reserved and calm.

reticent.definitionKo: 말수가 적고 성격이 부드럽거나 상냥하지 않다.
reticent.englishDescription: Not talking much and being unkind and not gentle.

reviewer.englishDescription: A person who criticizes, judges, or reviews professionally.
A person who criticizes, judges, or reviews professionally.

reviewer.definitionKo: 글이나 예술 작품 등을 비평하는 사람.
reviewer.englishDescription: A person who criticizes a piece of writing, a work of art, etc.

revolving.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 중심으로 하여 그 주위를 빙빙 돎.
revolving.englishDescription: An act of circling around a certain object.

rewarding.englishDescription: Having a big value or rewarding quality.

rubbing.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of rubbing or scrubbing something lightly.

russia.definitionKo: 유럽의 동부와 시베리아에 걸쳐 있는 나라. 세계에서 가장 넓은 나라로 북쪽으로는 북극해, 동쪽으로는 태평양과 접해 있다. 공용어는 러시아어이고 수도는 모스크바이다.
russia.englishDescription: A country between Eastern Europe and Siberia; the largest country in the world, it adjoins the Arctic to the north and the Pacific to the east; its official language is Russian and its capital is Moscow.

sabangchigi.definitionKo: 땅바닥에 여러 칸을 구분해 그려 놓고, 그 안에서 돌을 한 발로 차서 차례로 다음 칸으로 옮겨 가는 어린이 놀이.
sabangchigi.englishDescription: A Korean-style hopscotch, or a children's game in which a player moves through a series of outlined spaces on the ground by kicking a small flat stone from one space to another.

sajupalja.definitionKo: 한 사람의 생년월일과 태어난 시간을 가리키는 여덟 글자.
sajupalja.englishDescription: fate; destiny: Literally, eight characters corresponding to his/her date and time of birth.

sand.definitionKo: 자연의 힘으로 잘게 부스러진 돌의 알갱이.
sand.englishDescription: Grains of rock that have been broken into tiny pieces by the force of nature.

script.definitionKo: 영화나 연극을 만들기 위하여 배우의 대사와 동작, 장면에 대하여 자세히 적은 글.
script.englishDescription: A detailed description of the actors' lines, actions and scenes for a movie or play.

script.definitionKo: 영화나 연극, 드라마를 만들기 위해 쓴 글.
script.englishDescription: A piece of writing used to make a movie, play or drama.

script.definitionKo: 연극이나 영화에서, 대사나 장면의 설명 등을 적어 놓은 글.
script.englishDescription: In a play or movie, the text that gives the actors' lines or describes the scenes, etc.

script.definitionKo: 인쇄하거나 발표하기 위하여 쓴 글이나 그림.
script.englishDescription: A writing or picture created to print or publish.

selective.definitionKo: 일정한 기준을 따라 가려서 따로 나누거나 추려 내는.
selective.englishDescription: Sorting or picking out according to set standards.

selective.definitionKo: 여럿 중에서 필요한 것을 골라 뽑는.
selective.englishDescription: Choosing what one needs among many.

self-consciousness.definitionKo: 자신이 처한 상황이나 자신의 행동, 성격 등에 대해 깨닫는 일.
self-consciousness.englishDescription: The act of realizing how one's situation, behavior, personality, etc., is.

self-consciousness.definitionKo: 자기의 입장이나 능력 등을 스스로 느끼거나 깨달음.
self-consciousness.englishDescription: Becoming aware of or realizing own position, situation, ability, etc.

senegal.definitionKo: 아프리카 서해안에 있는 나라. 주요 생산물로는 땅콩과 인을 함유한 광석 등이 있다. 공용어는 프랑스어이고 수도는 다카르이다.
senegal.englishDescription: A country located on the western coast of Africa; it is a major producer of peanuts, and ores containing phosphorus, etc.; its official language is French and its capital is Dakar.

seollal.definitionKo: 한국의 명절의 하나. 음력 1월 1일로 아침에 가족과 친척들이 모여 차례를 지내고 어른들께 세배를 올린다. 떡국을 먹고 윷놀이, 널뛰기, 연날리기 같은 민속놀이를 즐기기도 한다.
seollal.englishDescription: One of the national holidays in Korea; on the first day of the year by the lunar calendar, families and relatives gather to hold an ancestral ritual called Charye, and the young perform Sebae, a traditional Korean bow, to their elders; people have tteokguk, sliced rice cake soup, and enjoy folk games such as yunnori, a traditional Korean family board game, as well as neolttwigi, riding a standing see-saw, and yeonnalligi, kiteflying.

sequential.englishDescription: Doing something one after another according to the set order.

shabby.englishDescription: A person's clothes being worn out and his/her appearance being sloppy.

shabby.definitionKo: 집이나 옷차림이 제대로 갖추어지지 못하고 지저분하다.
shabby.englishDescription: A person's house or clothing being not equipped properly and being dirty.
One's appearance or attire being scruffy and miserable.
Being old and worn out, making it look worthless.

shabby.definitionKo: 먹거나 입는 것 등이 하찮고 지저분하다.
